profile.headline: A knack for building scalable embedded platforms.
profile.summary: Experienced Embedded Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the semiconductors industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in Embedded C/C++ Firmware, Debugging, in both RTOS and Linux.

positions.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Internet of Things (IoT) · LTE · Embedded Software · Device Drivers · Embedded Devices

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Firmware development of vehicle components leveraging MCU platform and Android, a glue logic between hardware and software for next generation electric bikes and scooters.

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
- MCU firmware of RTOS and device drivers for MFi, GPS, Accelerometer, RTC, Fuel Gauge, Battery Charger Controller
- System power management PMIC

positions.title: Project Lead and Manager
positions.description:
+ Lead and manage the engineering team of 5 to deliver custom Linux platform solution for all-in-one printer’s controller board
+ Coordinate between US and Japan engineering teams driving product requirements and development milestones
+ Platform gate keeper: handle review of other commit requests from other teams to ensure Platform's quality and stability
+ Hands-on role with Team's development tasks and lead defining platform architecture for future products

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
+ Key platform engineer contributing to successful release of high performance laser printers to market (Konica Minolta Bizhub 4050 and 4750)
+ Design and implement Asynchronous Multiprocessing (AMP) Linux platform for ARM A7 and A53 cores, i.e. each core runs independent Linux OS. The work involves customization to U-Boot boot-loader, GIC interrupt routing policy, Inter-Processor Interrupt synchronization, and shared DRAM allocation. 
+ Design and implement low-power solution for AMP system using Linux power domain that tracks device activities (USB, DMA, Ethernet, etc.) to safeguard DRAM before entering DDR Self Refresh mode. Helped existing machine in the field dropped its power consumption from 4 Watt to 2.5 Watt by only firmware change to meet ErP Lot 26 EU Regulation.
+ Responsible for board bring-up activities for new printer products
+ Develop board’s manufacturing test firmware ensure hardware quality in assembly
+ Back-port Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) security fixes
+ Design and develop build system that supports cross compilation and packaging of Linux kernel and its device drivers, system tools, and other software packages.
+ Responsible for distribution of toolchain and build environment to multiple engineering teams and 3rd party

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
+ Develop Microchips PIC firmware & integrate them into Linux Kernel.
+ Develop Linux Kernel USB, I2C, SMBus and GPIO device drivers.
+ Develop Smart Battery Charger for Li-Ion Batteries for Electric Meter.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
+ Provide Linux Support Packages (LSP) and development environment for embedded PowerPC and ARM-926EJ-S
+ Port firmware, device drivers, and video recording application on both Windows and Linux platform
+ Set up and performs signature verification tests for Windows device driver
+ Board bring-up for embedded Video Recorder and IP Camera
+ Various performance benchmark tests and tweaks
+ Add features and bug fixing to video processing firmware on Tensilica Xtensa RISC processor

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Bring-up new embedded system boards after new hardware revisions; write and modify drivers for customized in-house embedded system with DENX Linux Kernel 2.4.25; ports old firmware to new system; fix/debug USB to serial wireless modem device drivers from Sierra and Siemens.  Design Implement file system structure for reliable boot.

positions.title: IBM Intern
positions.description: setup large backup system to test for device drivers' behavior under multiple Operating Systems, on multiple CPU architectures, maintain network and computers.  Also needed to do shell scripting and Perl scripting.

positions.title: Senior Project
positions.description: Design and Implement Wireless Remote Control Car with wireless live video feedback, GPS positioning, MP3 playback, analog sensors, and internet control interface via web server.  All features and functionalities can be remotely control from a GameBoy Advance©.
